function onlyNumber(x: number) {
  return x;
}

function nullish(x: number | null | undefined) {
  return x ?? onlyNumber(x);
}
function chainBase(o: { b: string } | undefined) {
  return o?.b ?? o.b;
}
function afterward(x: number | null) {
  const y = x ?? 0;
  return onlyNumber(x);
}
function assignedOnRight(x: string | undefined) {
  let z: number;
  const r = x ?? (z = 1);
  return z;
}
